description: Section 3 (line 72) REMOVES the `gig` earner entirely on the grounds it 'requires a bank account + KYC = human credential = violates INV-MODE.' Section 5.3 (line 126) then designates that same removed earner as the canonical reference implementation for the skip-floor invariant: 'gig `passprep.py` FIND-005 is the reference implementation.' Pointing the INV-KEEP-ALIVE invariant at a component the spec just deleted leaves the invariant without a live reference. Additionally the external 'FIND-005' identifier is cited with no definition or link inside this spec, so a reader cannot locate the referenced implementation.

evidence.snippet: Removed: `gig` (Coconala/dealwork) ... [then] gig `passprep.py` FIND-005 is the reference implementation.
